newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam seeks 256,000/T diesel/jet in 1Q tender.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam seeks 256,000/T diesel/jet in 1Q tender.

text.p: State-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) has issued a tender to buy 256,000 tonnes of diesel and jet fuel for delivery during January to March 1997, a company official said on Monday.
The tender also seeks 189,000 tonnes of 170-centistoke grade fuel oil with a 3.0-percent sulphur content, and 153,000 tonnes of 83-octane gasoline with a lead content of 0.15 gram per litre.
The tender closes at 1600 hours Hanoi time on December 27 and offers will be valid until close of business on January 5, 1997, the official said.

The tender stipulates that quality and quantity of the oil products shall be determined at the loading port by a mutually agreed independent inspector whose costs are to be shared equally between seller and buyer.

In any case, buyer can refuse to discharge cargo in the event the quality of products tested in samples from the vessel before discharge does not meet guaranteed specifications until buyer and seller are satisfied with the product quality.
